title: rag.py pack ranks a table's rows before its budget cut
goal: pack prints a CSV article's matching rows by score, not in file order, before it cuts at the character budget, so a question about one model reaches its row of kb/public/claude/models.csv; today a Claude Opus 5.5 model question never reaches models.csv although its row is on line 4, and ST-dtqlqjs7 moved the Haiku 5.5 row to the first data row to be cited. Found in SP-hm4qgf3t's run and confirmed by its review.

run: import subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','Claude Opus 5.5 model id context window max output'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and 'models.csv' in p.stdout else 1)

notes: Merged from ST-wj6acdro “The pack can lead with a fact held only in a data table, so a question answered by claude/models.csv packs it first” at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage: Same defect as ST-z5uh6oj7 (pack does not surface a claude/models.csv row for a model question); its Sonnet 5.5 pack still leads with ci-and-headless.md, not models.csv. Its goal: Found in SP-vayhvwfy (ST-hcc7a3fd, gate g1): the false-good question 'Claude Sonnet 5.5 model release capabilities pricing context window' is answered by claude/models.csv, but rag.py pack leads with agents/agent-caching.md; an eval row expecting the csv fails on its path and doc2query expands only .md facts, so no eval row or expansion could fix it. The pack ranks a data table's rows as it ranks article facts (or an expansion route exists for them), and that question packs with models.csv in the lead. Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import subprocess,sys;o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','Claude Sonnet 5.5 model release capabilities pricing context window','--budget','300'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;lead=o.split('## ',1)[-1].split(chr(10),1)[0];print('lead:',lead[:80]);sys.exit(0 if 'models.csv' in lead else 1)"]} Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 2 of 13, "Fitness 2: pack ranking and pool eval correctness"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F1: the held-out answer rate (lookup_heldout.csv).
